Q: Creating clickable link to text file in Powershell A:

You can use the .net class System.Uri which should handle all the slashes and prefixing for you. Not sure how clickable it is though!

$path = "C:/path/to/file.ext"
$uri = [System.Uri]::new($path)
Write-Host $uri.AbsoluteUri

Result: file:///C:/path/to/file.ext

Q: How to render html renderfragment code in blazor A:

When you use @"" this is consider a Verbatim String Literal not razor syntax. So remove the double quotes and you're just fine.

Q: How to implement request-scoped logging in NodeJS? A:

I know this response might come a bit too late, but, if you haven't found a reliable solution yet, maybe you can consider https://www.npmjs.com/package/@logbee/express.

This is an ExpressJS middleware I created exactly for the purpuse of saving request-scoped logs, together with all the relevant HTTP details, to logbee.net (a log aggregation platform I also created).

You can see an example of a captured middleware request here: https://logbee.net/Components/RequestModal?applicationId=4f729841-b103-460e-a87c-be6bd72f0cc9&requestId=c200e388-d564-4b9f-a042-20568201bced&atoken=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJSZXF1ZXN0SWQiOiJjMjAwZTM4OC1kNTY0LTRiOWYtYTA0Mi0yMDU2ODIwMWJjZWQiLCJleHAiOjE3ODczODUyMDd9.H7UfTqgvcdNiToSBO4dV_19VxGhpIX7NwMDqi27fUSw
